findings.one_line: The promised all-tests rough-design frontier is still explicitly to-prove (as are its spectral and adaptive consumers); the current core instead delivers only the high-smoothness root-n branch plus a uniform-design lower bound, so it cannot be positioned as the proposed regime-wise frontier.

The high-smoothness root-n theorem lacks a theorem-level comparison to the closest SCoDiTE first-order/product-rate result and empirical-HOIF result (matched assumptions, target, estimator class, and exact advance); the broad prose assertions and unmapped comparator table do not establish novelty of this delivered branch.

The headline test is calibrated by V_star, an expressly noncomputable supremum over the model class and all sample sizes, so it is an existence result rather than the claimed usable size-valid choice; provide an evaluable calibration procedure or state and position the deliverable unambiguously as oracle-only.
